device.type: DVB-S2 / DVB-T2 / DVB-C HD combo receiver
device.soc: ALi M3516 (M3503 family rev B dual-CPU MIPS32 + SEE)
device.demod: internal ALi M3503 DVB-S2 + DVB-T2/C combo demodulator

image.layout: bootloader 0x000000 (DVBS2---0.2.0), MemCfg 0x01EF00, maincode and SEE chunks -- 8 MB flash

simulator.note: Boots as M3503 with rev-B chip ID: sets up cache-as-RAM stack, unpacks split SEE and maincode, prints 'model = 4:652HD COMBO' and 'MC: APP  init ok'.

desc: The V1.11.19423 firmware for the AB CryptoBox 652HD Combo receiver built on the ALi M3516 dual-core SoC.
Supports satellite DVB-S2 and terrestrial/cable DVB-T2/C reception.
